newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:

Vessels: Birlad loading 45,200 tonnes soybeans/meal. Adalbert Antonov loading 31,000 tonnes soymeal. Ruby I loading 32,823 tonnes soymeal. Stjepov loading 25,000 tonnes soymeal. Ocean Transporter loading 23,100 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, six vessels to load soymeal, one for soybeans and three for mixed cargo.
Road: 548 trucks carrying soybeans arrived on June 10, as well as 389 trucks with soymeal and 79 trucks with vegetable oils including soyoil.
Vessels: At public terminal, Pythagoras of Samo loading 36,000 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, three vessels to load soybeans.
At Cargill private terminal, Studzianski waiting to load 27,836 tonnes soymeal.
Road: 288 trucks carrying 7,206 tonnes soybeans arrived on June 10 as well as five trucks with 135 tonnes soymeal.
Rail: 32 wagons arrived with 1,694 tonnes soybeans.
